narrative.intro: Haskell obligated $262M in federal contract funding in FY2026 to date. Obligations rose up 582.3% year over year. Haskell received 9 awards so far, with an average award size of $29.1M. Year-to-date obligations concentrate in Construction and a small amount in Engineering Services. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $226M, making DHS the largest buyer for FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense is the second buyer with $35.8M in obligations. Historical obligations show smaller annual totals: FY21 was $34.3M, FY22 was $54.6M, FY23 was $57.5M, FY24 was $33.4M, and FY25 was $38.3M. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).

sections.heading: How did Haskell's FY2026 obligations compare to prior years?
sections.body: Haskell obligated $262M in FY2026 to date, well above each prior listed year. Fiscal-year obligations were $34.3M in FY21, $54.6M in FY22, $57.5M in FY23, $33.4M in FY24, and $38.3M in FY25. Obligations rose up 582.3% year over year.

sections.heading: Who are Haskell's top federal buyers and what markets do they fund?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $226M and the Department of Defense obligated $35.8M in FY2026 to date. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest NAICS market at $262M, with Engineering Services at $5K.

faq.q: How much does Haskell make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Haskell has obligated $262M from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Haskell received 9 awards so far, with an average award size of $29.1M. Historical annual obligations include $34.3M in FY21, $54.6M in FY22, $57.5M in FY23, $33.4M in FY24, and $38.3M in FY25.

The Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Defense buy from Haskell. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $226M and the Department of Defense obligated $35.8M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Haskell sell to the government?
faq.a: Haskell sells construction and engineering services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $262M and Engineering Services accounts for $5K in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: Which Haskell contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: Current records show obligations and award totals for FY2026 to date, but no expiring-contract table was provided. The dataset lists 9 awards and an average award size of $29.1M, with current-year totals partial (fiscal year to date).
